children: an AI-driven technology platform operating at the intersection of IP, data and commerce engineered to empower creators, media entrepreneurs, publishers and brands, today announced its participation in the Lake Street Capital Markets Best Ideas Growth (BIG10) Conference taking place in New York City on September 10, 2026.

Paradium.AI’s Chief Executive Officer Paul Edmondson, President Chris Hunter, and Principal Financial Officer Geoffrey Wait will be available for one-on-one meetings with attending investors throughout the day. To request a meeting, investors are encouraged to contact their Lake Street representative or Paradium.AI’s investor relations team at

Paradium.AI, Inc. (NYSE American: PAAI) is an AI-driven technology platform operating at the intersection of IP, data and commerce engineered to empower creators, media entrepreneurs, publishers and brands to perform at the speed and scale of AI. Powered by our flagship technologies Encore, InfoSentience and Cutter Studios, our unified ecosystem combines cutting-edge AI technology, multi-channel distribution, and scalable monetization. Anchored by our owned portfolio of iconic brands, including Parade, The Street, Men’s Journal, and Athlon Sports, we provide the tools, data and reach that enable businesses to serve and grow audiences and unlock long-term value.
